edges: State Road 878 acts as a spur route of the Don Shula Expressway.
State Road 878 provides access to U.S. Route 1 near South Miami.
State Road 878 meets Galloway Road shortly after passing through the 87th Avenue toll gantry.
State Road 878 passes over the Palmetto Expressway without an interchange.
State Road 878 meets its eastern terminus at South Dixie Highway.
State Road 878 has two toll gantries along its length.
As of July 1, 2013, the cost for a two-axle vehicle to travel the entire length of State Road 878 is $0.50 with a SunPass transponder.
Tolling along State Road 878 began on July 17, 2010.
